verdict.rationale: Community Phone offers business calling and texting, so CRM call/text logging is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack shows no CRM integration or automatic logging against contacts. In-app call history and dashboard texting are adjacent features, not CRM sync, and no API surface was found (OpenAPI probes returned 404).

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact
